title: Rules of the road
brief: Marketing needs one tagline per product, aimed at a given audience. Brand rules: at most 8 words, must include the product name, no exclamation marks, and none of the banned buzzwords (revolutionary, game-changer, cutting-edge, next-level).

lesson.summary: A model can only follow rules it has been told. Good constraints are explicit and checkable, and they include the negatives: what to avoid, what is banned, and what the output must never contain.
lesson.why_it_matters: Brand guidelines, legal disclaimers, and compliance rules are all constraints. If they aren't in the prompt, they won't be in the output.
lesson.strong_example: Write one tagline for {{product}} aimed at {{audience}}. Max 8 words. Must include "{{product}}". No exclamation marks. Never use: revolutionary, game-changer. Output only the tagline.

starter_prompt: Write a catchy tagline for {{product}}. The audience is {{audience}}.

vars.audience: hikers who hate carrying heavy gear

test_cases.golden_output: SolarSip: clean water, lighter pack, longer trails.
NapNest: better baby sleep, calmer nights for you.
LedgerLite turns tax season into tax minutes.

rubric: The tagline speaks directly to the stated audience
The tagline is catchy and memorable
hints: Count the rules in the brief. How many of them does your prompt actually state?
This is about explicit constraints. The model doesn't know your brand rules, so list each one plainly, including what NOT to do (banned words, punctuation, extra commentary).
Add a 'Rules:' list: at most 8 words; must include {{product}}; no exclamation marks; never use revolutionary, game-changer, cutting-edge, next-level; output only the tagline.
reference_prompt:
You are a senior copywriter known for short, punchy taglines.

Write one tagline for {{product}}, aimed at {{audience}}.

Rules:
- At most 8 words.
- Must include the exact name "{{product}}".
- No exclamation marks.
- Never use these words: revolutionary, game-changer, cutting-edge, next-level.
- Output only the tagline: no quotes, no explanation, no alternatives.
